description: Machine-readable repo profiles for enforcement routing, token policy and keepalive. This tracked copy is the example a fork registers its repos in. A checkout whose olivercode.local.json names private repos reads the real registry from the first one holding olivercode/repo-profiles.json.
_hookVariant_note: Optional per-profile field. Set it to a short reason string when a repo must run a pre-commit hook that differs from core/templates/project/pre-commit (a repo-specific governance path, a gate whose checker only exists there). `olivercode health` then reports the divergence as WARN instead of FAIL, and `sync-hooks` skips the repo instead of overwriting it. It never excuses a MISSING or unexecutable hook -- those still fail, because that is the fail-open case. Remove the field to bring the repo back under the template. TRADE-OFF: a declared variant is SKIPPED by sync-hooks, so it also stops receiving template fixes -- including security ones. Observed for real: a perl guard that closed a fail-open in the emoji gate reached every repo except the one carrying a variant. Re-check a variant repo by hand whenever the template's gates change.
_path_note: Optional per-profile field. Without it a repo is located at <fleet-root>/<profile-name>, the sibling convention. A `path` here is shared by every machine, so use it only for a location that is the same everywhere (relative to the fleet root). A path that belongs to one machine goes in that machine's olivercode.local.json under repoPaths.
_suites_note: Convention only -- nothing currently reads this field. Kept as the declared shape for delegated validation suites (see docs/BACKLOG.md D2). Do not assume setting it causes anything to run.
